tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get profile summary
tools.description: Return the portfolio owner's professional summary: name, headline, location, and a short bio covering finance systems, ERP, regulatory compliance, and AI-assisted automation experience.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.title: Get contact information
tools.description: Return the portfolio owner's public contact channels: email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and location.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.title: List flagship case studies
tools.description: Return the list of flagship case studies featured on the portfolio, each with an id, title, client context, and a short summary.

tools.name: get_case_study
tools.title: Get case study details
tools.description: Return full details for a single flagship case study by id. Valid ids: 'erp', 'zatca', 'ey', 'automation' (use list_case_studies first).
